title: Reflected Schrödinger Bridge Matching
tldr_zh: 把 α-DSBM 推广到单位立方体上的反射 Brownian 参考过程，样本不越界，训练开销约 +1.5%
tldr_en: Extends alpha-DSBM to reflected Brownian reference on the unit cube via closed-form reflected score and bridge sampler; negligible overhead, samples stay in-domain.
key_numbers: MNIST->EMNIST FID 5.22 vs alpha-DSBM 6.41; MSD 0.356 vs 0.416 (Table 1)
AFHQ cat->wild FID 26.1 vs 27.6, MSD 0.084 vs 0.131; wild->cat FID 33.8 vs 31.5 (Table 1)
Training time 32 h vs 31.5 h (MNIST), 109 h vs 108 h (AFHQ) (Sec. 5)
alpha-DSBM: 100% of MNIST samples have out-of-bounds pixels, avg 46% pixels; AFHQ ~2% entries (Sec. 5)
